TEXT: [FI] Well then, since you said you're going to help out, let's hurry and get some work done.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] However, there isn't anything you, a complete novice, can help out with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh, is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] How much do you know about the creation of manga?

TEXT: [FI] Honestly, pretty much nothing at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I see... If so, I'll start from the basics.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There are three phases during the creation of manga if we were to divide it accordingly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] First, the plot. This refers to creating a type of story, whatever the genre or category. It's the same for a novel and movie as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Even the same goes for manga. We just need to write down the outline of the story. Even among professionals, there are people who only work on

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] this to bring out original works.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Up next is the storyboard. From this phase onwards, it's something only manga has. In simpler terms, it means to draw a rough copy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Deciding the panel layout and character positions for example. There are also people who only work specifically on this phase of the creation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Well, even though I said quite a bit, it doesn't matter if you don't get it. These things have no relation to an assistant's job.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] However, this is essential for the process of creating a manga. That's why it's required of you to know this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Finally, the last phase is the manuscript. Your work, is to do the final touching up on it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Even if it's you, I believe you should at least know what 'fill in the colors' means, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's it. This is basically the work that you'll be doing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However, I never used a pen to draw before... is that all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe... If this were the past, that would certainly be a big problem.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But nowadays, it's possible to use the computer to draw manga. Even with your lack of skill, completing this won't be a problem.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-Is that so... Incredible...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Speaking of which, I'll be counting on you for the things you can do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] First you must understand the basics of using it. We should be able to complete that by today if it goes according to plan.

TEXT: [FI] Huh? Is it okay doing just that?

TEXT: [FI] That said, there are two types of errors that one can make while working on the computer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Deleting the wrong files, as well as overwriting the original backup copy. These are the two.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's right. Furthermore, all kinds of mistakes will appear if one isn't used to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] For the sake of avoiding that, one must have the habit of frequently making backups. That's why before you do anything else, please get used to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Understood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But... even though I said I was going to help you... Wouldn't I just drag you down?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's within my calculations that there are bound to be some accidents, so rest assured.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Working alone and working with someone are two completely different things...

TEXT: [FI] ...Kuroneko?
